sentence: This project builds a way for researchers in many fields to learn chip design and use chip design software and hardware.
This project focuses on AI research in a complex systems institute where researchers work on digital healthcare, security, modeling, and prediction.
This project builds a sensor worn in one ear that tracks face and eye movements and draws 3D facial animations without a camera.
This project studies how copper connections that join chips vertically fail and tries to make them more reliable.
This project designs recyclable polymer materials that can be broken down into their building blocks under mild conditions.
This project builds ways to teach robots with many fingers to handle objects by combining vision, touch, and vibration.
This project builds materials that capture proteins secreted by stem cells so their healing effects last longer.
This project builds computer tools that find the rules behind how microbial communities in hot spring microbial mats cooperate and stay stable.
This project uses tree rings to build detailed records of past extreme rainfall and temperature.
This project tests whether a cultured network of neurons on a benchtop can be trained to perform a sensory task and a motor behavior.
This project builds ways to choose training samples so deep learning can solve high-dimensional partial differential equations.
This project builds synthetic polymers that store digital information and can be read with nanopore readers.
This project builds computer methods that find gene patterns by position inside tissue using data from single cells.
This project designs ceramics that resist fracture at low temperatures and creep at high temperatures using crystal structures that interlock.
This project tests whether early traits of a fossil fish population can predict how the population evolved over a long time.
This project builds efficient and safe algorithms for bilevel optimization problems in planning and control.
This project builds a storage system that stores and moves large amounts of data faster and more flexibly.
